WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref, 
    SUM(articount) as total_artifacts 
  FROM scanfeatures 
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_artifacts) as overall_total 
  FROM site_totals
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(st.total_artifacts AS FLOAT) / gt.overall_total) as avg_share
  FROM site_totals st
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
  WHERE gt.overall_total IS NOT NULL
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.zoneref,
    st.total_artifacts,
    CAST(st.total_artifacts AS FLOAT) / gt.overall_total as share,
    CAST(st.total_artifacts AS FLOAT) / gt.overall_total - avs.avg_share as diff_from_avg
  FROM site_totals st
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
  CROSS JOIN avg_share avs
  WHERE gt.overall_total IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  total_artifacts,
  share,
  diff_from_avg
FROM shares
ORDER BY CASE WHEN diff_from_avg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, diff_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
